subject: English Home Language

show.line: Can not becomes can't. I am becomes I'm. The apostrophe takes the place of the missing letters!

rounds.prompt: Do not. Which short form is right?
She is happy. Which short form fits?
We are late. Say it the short way.
It's raining. Which two words does it's stand for?
Which sentence uses the short form correctly?
Long form or short form? Sort the cards.

rounds.text: I'm sure they won't be late.
accept: i'm sure they won't be late
im sure they wont be late

hints: Squash two words together. Put an apostrophe where letters fall out.
Can't is can not. Won't is will not.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will shorten does not.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! The apostrophe goes where the 'o' was. Doesn't.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's fix it together. Does not. Take out the 'o', add the apostrophe. Doesn't!

parent_line: Can write short forms like don't and it's with an apostrophe.
